programme.title: Quest For Love
programme.desc: Mackenzie travels to Costa Rica for work. Her best friend Ethan comes along to get romantic inspiration for his action /adventure novel. Mackenzie has loved Ethan for a long time, but he only sees her as a friend--until a tourist named Lucas makes Ethan see Mackenzie in a new light.

programme.title: Surviving Love
programme.desc: Jessica Miller is a typical Millennial, graduating from college who must learn to navigate the real world. When her father presents her with a gift from her mother who died when she was 9, she must find the faith and courage to open the box, while trying to find her way in this difficult world. When she befriends a spiritual and vivacious African-American woman, suffering from dementia, she begins to understand the secrets to life and the courage to open a box of memories.

programme.title: Our Wild Hearts
programme.desc: Willow (Cambrie Schroder), a determined young teenager, is obsessed with the idea of meeting the father she never knew. She leaves her cushy life in Malibu to travel to the Sierra Nevada mountains, where she pays a surprise visit to Jack (Ricky Schroder), a rugged cowboy who has no idea he’s a father. As the two struggle to bond, Willow makes a connection with a wild mustang, Bravo. Jack wants to capture and tame the magnificent horse, but Willow is convinced he needs to be free. Will the wild stallion that brought them together end up tearing them apart?

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty Next Door
programme.desc: A woman with a condition that causes her to fall asleep when feeling strong emotions falls in love with her new neighbor. Will she be able to stay awake to make her dreams a reality?

programme.title: Just For Showmance
programme.desc: When Tara Thompson’s presenting career begins to stall her PR team encourage her go on a TV show to marry a man she’s never met, her ‘perfect match’ Joe. Tara reluctantly agrees, however goes on secret mission to track down Joe to explain the marriage is just for show.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Not Cinderella’s Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: The Shunning
programme.desc: All her life Katie Lapp has longed for the forbidden things, but will her dreams come at a price too dear to pay?
